<!-- pr-reviewer: c555b4eea949d82b55995249cb8ed8ba4a70e46d -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The action row is still not visible in a 720 px window. The new test measures against the wrong edge.

Review tier: UI only. The PR does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry.

## What looks good

- The change is small and stays in one page. No command, layer or schema changes.
- `Refresh` on the `Library` row is a good use of the row. The `reread |= ...` line keeps the `true` that `Refresh` sets.
- `layout_page_setup_machine` is updated, and the `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes up by one.
- The body has before and after screenshots, a `Changelog:` line, a decision file and `Fixes #2105`.
- The PR merges cleanly with `main`. It changes no snapshot PNG, no process file and no dependency.

## Results, merged with main (`971c23faa`), built locally

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: ui build | ok |
| ui suite `lib` | 1250 passed, 4 failed, 7 ignored |
| ui suites `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool` | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | 0 warnings |

The 4 failures are the `frame_cost_caches` / `frame_cost_probe` tests. They panic at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/frame_cost_probe.rs:278` on the fig8 fixture. This PR does not touch that code. Issue #2766 tracks the defect. They are not a finding against this PR.

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code.

Mutation (local only): I put the `machine_page.rs` of `main` back. `the_machine_page_buttons_fit_without_scrolling_at_720_px` and `layout_page_setup_machine` became red. With the PR code they are green.

## Requested before merge

1. **The action row is hidden behind the `Close` footer.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/machine_page.rs:118-126` compares the buttons with the bottom of the Properties leaf. The leaf is not the visible area of the page. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:109-112` gives the scroll area the leaf height minus 40 px, and `pages.rs:166-173` draws a separator and the `Close` button in those 40 px.

   I printed the rectangles in `shell_harness()` (1280x720) with the PR code:

   ```
   leaf        [[990.0 104.0] - [1264.0 682.0]]
   Close       [[996.0 648.0] - [1035.5 666.0]]
   Load other  [[1016.0 644.0] - [1091.3 668.0]]
   Edit        [[1099.3 644.0] - [1174.7 668.0]]
   Clear       [[1182.7 644.0] - [1258.0 668.0]]
   ```

   The scroll area ends at about y = 642. The buttons start at y = 644. Thus the full row is below the visible area, in the same band as the `Close` footer. The user must still scroll. The "after" screenshot in the PR body shows the same result: only the top edge of the three buttons shows above the `Close` separator.

   Please do the two steps that follow:
   - Change the test to compare each button bottom with the visible bottom of the page. The top of the footer `Close` button in the Properties pane is a correct edge. The bottom of the scroll area is also correct. The test must be red on the current head.
   - Change the layout until that test is green. The row needs about 26 px more than this PR reclaims.

2. **The body and the decision file say more than the result.** The body says "the action row is fully visible without scrolling". The screenshot does not show that. After the fix of item 1, replace the "after" screenshot and correct the text. The body and `docs/decisions/2105-machine-buttons-720.md:10` name a button "New". The page has "Load other", "Edit" and "Clear". Please use the labels of the page.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The combo is now about 120 px wide in the harness, and "Tormach 770MX" fits. The body says a narrower panel was not tested. A long library label is cut by the combo, which is the usual behaviour.
- The screenshots are on the `screenshots` branch of the fork and not in the PR tree. That is correct.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Taking this PR to draft: the review found the action row is still below the visible bottom, behind the `Close` footer. Fixing on the same branch: the test gets the correct visible-bottom edge (it must be red first), then the layout reclaims the missing ~26 px. The after screenshot and the body text will be corrected after a GUI check.

Both findings are addressed on the same branch, head `b810c98a7`.

1. Wrong edge: the test now queries `Close` from the Properties pane
   and compares each button bottom with the `Close` top (+1 px). It
   went red on the old head with your exact numbers: `Load other
   [[1016.0 644.0] - [1091.3 668.0]]` against `Close [[996.0 648.0] -
   [1035.5 666.0]]`. The layout fix reclaims more than the 26 px: the
   row now paints at 570..594. The page uses a 2 px row rhythm, the
   overview grid takes a `row_gap` parameter (the machine editor keeps
   4 px), and the two ownership help lines draw small and weak. All
   AccessKit labels and commands are unchanged.
2. Overclaim: the body and `docs/decisions/2105-machine-buttons-720.md`
   now name the real buttons ("Load other", "Edit", "Clear"; no "New")
   and state the measured y-values instead of the old "8 px overflow"
   claim. The after screenshot is retaken from the fixed build at the
   same 1280x720 crop.

Gate on `b810c98a7`: ui lib 1249 passed, 4 failed - only the known
`frame_cost` reds from #2766, which fail the same way on the parent
head. Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets`: 0 warnings. `layout_page_setup_machine`
stays green; only its stale "28 px" comment changed.
Flagging ready: quick pass is good on head `b810c98a7` - merges cleanly with main, the pinning test is named above, the gate ran on this head, the body is complete. Ready for the re-check.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

Review tier: UI only. This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation or geometry.

## Earlier findings

1. The test now compares each action button bottom with the top of the Properties pane's `Close` footer. The corrected test passes. The updated screenshot shows all three buttons above the footer without scrolling.
2. The body and the decision file name `Load other`, `Edit` and `Clear`. They state the corrected measurements. I opened both linked screenshots and checked the new result.

The change keeps the existing commands and AccessKit labels. The machine editor keeps its previous grid gap. The PR changes no dependency, process file, fixture, golden file or snapshot PNG.

## Results, built locally

I trial-merged the PR with upstream main `744c0847b04d54cfc6e3e8b24a21520c40b6bcef`. The merge was clean. All commands used the review worktree's own target directory. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | All 9 steps passed |
| UI build, `--no-run` | Passed |
| UI library | 1260 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 7 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `tap_hand` | 3 passed |
| `theme_example` | 3 passed |
| `theme_files` | 17 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed, no warnings |

The library run includes `the_machine_page_buttons_fit_without_scrolling_at_720_px`, `layout_page_setup_machine` and `layout_page_setup_post`. All passed. The earlier frame-cost failures did not occur on this trial merge.

The first command session ended with signal 15 during compilation. Its child build completed. The foreground retry also completed the full quick gate successfully.

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no test data, fixture directory or importer. The extra-suite rules do not apply.

Heavy lanes: none reached by this UI-only diff. Pixel snapshot tests were not run.

Mutations: none in this review. This is not a safety-tier change. I did not change the source code.

## Notes, not blocking

At `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_pages.rs:137` and `:152`, the smaller help text also affects the Post page. Both pages call `ownership`. The body's statement that this affects only the Machine page is inaccurate. The existing Post layout test passes. Please correct this scope note in the body.

The body does not claim support for panels narrower than the tested width. That limit remains untested.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
